card.title: TPS53219A single buck controller +5V STBY power rail analysis

source.title: TPS53219A +5V STBY Buck Controller and Pinout

claims.statement: The TPS53219A controller generates the +5V STBY rail from the +12V power supply.
claims.evidence: Annotated arrows connecting the +12V power supply input to the IC and the output to the +5V STBY rail.

card.caveats: The image provides a functional overview and pinout but does not provide specific voltage measurement values or diode mode readings for troubleshooting.
